meaning_en: To stop working (for a machine or vehicle).
example_en: My car broke down on the way to work.
examples_extra: Our old car broke down on the motorway.
The washing machine keeps breaking down this month.

meaning_en: To enter a building illegally, often by force.
meaning_fa: به زور وارد شدن، سرقت کردن
example_en: Someone tried to break into the house last night.
examples_extra: Thieves broke into the shop late last night.
Someone tried to break in through the open window.

meaning_en: To ask someone to come to a place.
example_en: I will call for you at 7 PM.
examples_extra: My father will call for me at six and drive me home.
The nurse will call for the doctor when the patient wakes up.
note_fa: یعنی به دنبال کسی رفتن یا او را صدا زدن.

meaning_en: To continue doing something.
example_en: Please carry on with your work.
examples_extra: Please carry on with your work; I will be back soon.
They will carry on walking even if it starts to rain.
note_fa: یعنی ادامه دادن؛ مثل carry on with your work.

meaning_en: Used to encourage someone or hurry them.
example_en: Come on, we're going to be late!
examples_extra: Come on, we are going to be late!
She said, 'Come on, you can do it!'
note_fa: برای تشویق یا عجله: Come on! یعنی «بجنب!».

meaning_en: To lose your balance and drop to the ground.
example_en: The child ran too fast and fell over.
examples_extra: The child fell over and hurt his knee.
Be careful, or you'll fall over the step.

meaning_en: To discover a fact or piece of information.
example_en: I need to find out when the train leaves.
examples_extra: I just found out that she is moving to Canada.
Can you find out what time the train leaves?
note_fa: «فهمیدن و کشف کردن»؛ با know اشتباه نشود.

meaning_en: to arrive at a place, especially home.
example_en: What time did you get in last night?
examples_extra: What time does the train get in?
We got in very late last night.

meaning_en: to leave work or school.
example_en: What time do you get off work?
examples_extra: What time do you get off work?
She gets off at five today.
note_fa: تعطیل شدن از کار/مدرسه؛ get off work یعنی کار تمام شدن.

meaning_en: to have a good relationship with someone.
example_en: I get on well with my colleagues.
examples_extra: Do you get on with your neighbours?
They get on very well together.
note_fa: با کسی کنار آمدن/رابطه خوب داشتن؛ get on with somebody.

meaning_en: to make progress or manage a situation.
example_en: How are you getting on with your homework?
examples_extra: How did you get on in the exam?
She is getting on fine without help.
note_fa: پیشرفت کردن یا کنار آمدن؛ در امتحان: How did you get on?

meaning_en: Recover from an illness or a bad feeling.
example_en: She needs time to get over her cold.
examples_extra: He got over the flu in a week.
She is getting over a bad cold.
note_fa: از بیماری خوب شدن؛ get over the flu.

meaning_en: Get out of bed.
example_en: I get up at 7 AM every day.
examples_extra: I get up at seven every morning.
We all get up early on weekdays.
note_fa: یعنی از رختخواب بلند شدن؛ با wake up (بیدار شدن) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: Give something to someone for free.
example_en: I'm going to give away my old books.
examples_extra: She will give her old bike away.
Don't give away the ending of the film!
note_fa: دو معنی: رایگان دادن و لو دادن راز.

meaning_en: Stop trying to do something.
example_en: Don't give up on your dreams.
examples_extra: He wants to give up smoking this year.
Don't give up; keep trying!
note_fa: بعدش اسم یا فعل + ing می‌آید: give up smoking.

meaning_en: To leave your home for a holiday.
example_en: We want to go away for a week in summer.
examples_extra: They go away to Spain every summer.
We often go away for the weekend.

meaning_en: To leave a place or person.
example_en: Please go away and leave me alone.
examples_extra: The pain will finally go away.
Tell those kids to go away.

meaning_en: To return to a place or time.
example_en: I need to go back home now.
examples_extra: Let's go back to the hotel now.
She will go back to school.

meaning_en: To leave a place, often suddenly.
example_en: He went off without saying goodbye.
examples_extra: They went off without saying goodbye.
They are going off to explore the town.

meaning_en: To stop working, usually for electricity or power.
example_en: The electricity went off during the storm.
examples_extra: The lights often go off during storms.
The power can go off for hours.

meaning_en: To explode or fire, like a bomb or gun.
example_en: The bomb went off in the city center.
examples_extra: Bombs go off in war zones.
Fireworks go off all over the city on New Year's Eve.

meaning_en: Food or drink becomes bad and cannot be eaten.
example_en: Don't eat that milk; it has gone off.
examples_extra: This milk has gone off; don't drink it.
The fish will go off if you don't keep it cold.

meaning_en: To make a sudden loud noise, like an alarm.
example_en: My alarm clock goes off at 6 AM.
examples_extra: My alarm goes off at six every morning.
The fire alarm can go off suddenly.
note_fa: برای زنگ و آژیر: یعنی به صدا درآمدن.

meaning_en: To continue doing something.
example_en: Please go on with your story.
examples_extra: The show must go on.
Please go on; I'm listening.

meaning_en: To give things to many people.
example_en: The volunteers handed out food to the homeless.
examples_extra: A girl was handing out leaflets at the station.
They hand out free samples in the shopping centre.
note_fa: بین همه پخش کردن؛ sth یعنی «چیزی».

meaning_en: To spend time doing nothing important.
example_en: Don't just hang around; help me!
examples_extra: Teenagers often hang around the shopping centre after school.
We just hang around at home on quiet Sundays.
note_fa: پرسه زدن؛ غیررسمی برای «وقت گذرانی بی‌هدف».

meaning_en: To wait for a short period.
example_en: Please hold on while I find the number.
examples_extra: Hold on, I just need to get my coat.
Could you hold on a moment, please?

meaning_en: To do something more quickly.
example_en: Hurry up, or we will be late!
examples_extra: Hurry up, or we'll be late!
He will hurry up the stairs.

meaning_en: To create something new that did not exist before.
example_en: Who invented the telephone?
examples_extra: Who invented the telephone first?
She invented an excuse for being late.

meaning_en: To not include someone or something.
example_en: Don't leave me out of the game!
examples_extra: Do not leave anyone out of the team photo.
She felt hurt when they left her out.

meaning_en: Put your body in a flat position.
example_en: I need to lie down for a bit.
examples_extra: He lay down on the sofa and fell asleep.
You should lie down if you feel dizzy.

meaning_en: take care of a person.
example_en: My sister looks after her children very well.
examples_extra: They look after their grandchildren.
Nurses look after patients day and night.
note_fa: مراقبت از شخص؛ معادل take care of.

meaning_en: find information in a book or on a computer.
example_en: I need to look up this word in the dictionary.
examples_extra: Look the word up in a dictionary.
I looked up the train times online.
note_fa: در دیکشنری/اینترنت جست‌وجو کردن؛ look it up.

meaning_en: Invent a story or excuse.
example_en: He made up a story about being sick.
examples_extra: Don't make up stories like that!
He always makes up excuses.

meaning_en: To leave something out; not include.
example_en: Please omit your name from the list if you don't want to participate.
examples_extra: You can omit the last question.
He omitted my name from the list.
note_fa: یعنی حذف کردن؛ رسمی‌تر از leave out است.

meaning_en: to go and get someone from a place.
example_en: I will pick you up at 7 PM.
examples_extra: I will pick you up at six.
She picked the children up from school.
note_fa: دنبال کسی رفتن با ماشین؛ pick somebody up.

word: pick sth up [lift sth from the floor]
meaning_en: to lift something from the ground.
example_en: Please pick up your toys.
examples_extra: Pick up your toys from the floor.
She picked up the pen.

meaning_en: To arrange for something to happen later.
example_en: We had to postpone the meeting.
examples_extra: We had to postpone the meeting.
The match was postponed until Friday.

meaning_en: To start wearing clothes or accessories.
example_en: I put on my coat before going outside.
examples_extra: Put on your coat; it's cold.
She puts on her shoes quickly.
note_fa: put on (پوشیدن) با take off (درآوردن) متضاد است.

meaning_en: To return something to its original place.
example_en: Please put the book back on the shelf.
examples_extra: Put the book back on the shelf.
She put the keys back in her bag.

meaning_en: To delay doing something until a later time.
example_en: Don't put off your homework until the last minute.
examples_extra: Don't put off your homework.
We put the meeting off until Monday.
note_fa: با put off به معنی دلسرد کردن فرق دارد.

meaning_en: To start a machine or device.
example_en: Please put on the TV; my show is starting.
examples_extra: Put the heating on; it's cold.
She put the kettle on.

word: put sth on [put clothes on your body]
meaning_en: To place clothes on your body.
example_en: I need to put on my shoes.
examples_extra: He put his jacket on.
Put your shoes on quickly.

meaning_en: To raise something to a higher position.
example_en: We need to put up new curtains in the living room.
examples_extra: They put up the flag.
He put his hand up to ask.

meaning_en: To place clothes on your body.
example_en: Please put your shoes on.
examples_extra: He put his coat on and left.
She puts her glasses on to read.

meaning_en: To refuse to accept or believe something.
example_en: The committee rejected the new proposal.
examples_extra: They may reject your visa application.
He rejected the idea of moving abroad.
note_fa: رد کردن؛ با application و offer رایج.

meaning_en: To keep money for future use.
example_en: I am saving up for a new bike.
examples_extra: She is saving up for a car.
We saved up all year.
note_fa: پول پس‌انداز کردن؛ save up for something.

meaning_en: to start a journey
example_en: We set off early in the morning.
examples_extra: We set off early in the morning.
They set off for London.
note_fa: یعنی راه افتادن؛ set off on a journey.

meaning_en: To deal with a problem successfully.
meaning_fa: حل و فصل کردن، مرتب کردن
example_en: I need to sort out my papers.
examples_extra: We need to sort this problem out quickly.
She sorted out the tickets for everyone.
note_fa: حل‌وفصل کردن؛ sort out a problem.

meaning_en: Make a machine or light start.
example_en: Switch on the TV to watch the news.
examples_extra: Can you switch on the radio?
She switched on the lamp.

meaning_en: When an airplane leaves the ground.
example_en: The plane will take off soon.
examples_extra: Our plane takes off at 12.30.
The plane takes off at noon.

meaning_en: To employ someone.
example_en: The company decided to take on new staff.
examples_extra: They take him on as a driver.
We take on new assistants.

meaning_en: To return something to a shop.
example_en: I need to take this shirt back.
examples_extra: She takes the dress back tomorrow.
I take the book back today.

meaning_en: To remove a piece of clothing.
example_en: Please take off your coat.
examples_extra: Take your coat off now.
He takes off his jacket.

meaning_en: To reduce the volume or strength of something.
example_en: Please turn down the music.
examples_extra: Please turn the music down.
She turned down the heating.

meaning_en: To stop a machine or light working.
example_en: Please turn off the lights.
examples_extra: Turn off the lights, please.
He turned off his phone.

meaning_en: To start a machine or light working.
example_en: Can you turn on the TV?
examples_extra: Turn on the TV, please.
She turned on the lamp.

meaning_en: To stop a machine or light from working.
example_en: Don't forget to turn off your phone.
examples_extra: Please turn the tap off now.
He turned off the engine quickly.

meaning_en: To start a machine or light working.
example_en: Please turn on the computer.
examples_extra: Please turn the oven on now.
She turned on the computer quickly.

meaning_en: To refuse an offer or request.
example_en: They turned down my job application.
examples_extra: They turned down my offer.
She turned him down politely.

meaning_en: To arrive or appear unexpectedly.
meaning_fa: سر و کله پیدا شدن، ظاهر شدن
example_en: He didn't turn up for the meeting.
examples_extra: He turned up late for dinner.
She turned up completely unexpectedly.

meaning_en: To stop sleeping and become conscious.
example_en: I usually wake up early on weekdays.
examples_extra: I usually wake up at seven sharp daily.
She will wake up very late again today.

meaning_en: To improve your knowledge or skill quickly.
example_en: I need to brush up on my Spanish before the trip.
examples_extra: I need to brush up on my French.
She brushed up on her skills.
note_fa: تازه کردن دانش/مهارت؛ brush up on something.

meaning_en: To cancel an event or agreement.
example_en: They had to call off the wedding due to bad weather.
examples_extra: They called off the wedding.
The match was called off.

meaning_en: To succeed or happen as planned.
example_en: The plan didn't quite come off as expected.
examples_extra: The outdoor wedding came off without any problems.
Her ambitious plan to travel came off perfectly.

meaning_en: To visit someone's house.
example_en: Why don't you come over for dinner tonight?
examples_extra: Please do come over for dinner this Friday.
They came over to watch the big match.

meaning_en: To be subjected to something, like attack or criticism.
example_en: The government has come under heavy criticism.
examples_extra: The health minister came under heavy public criticism.
The new policy came under attack from unions.
note_fa: «در معرض قرار گرفتن»؛ come under attack.

meaning_en: To encounter difficulties or opposition.
example_en: We came up against unexpected problems during the project.
examples_extra: We may come up against unexpectedly strong local opposition.
She may come up against a very difficult problem.

meaning_en: To think or talk about something for a long time.
meaning_fa: در مورد چیزی فکر کردن، نشخوار فکری
example_en: Don't dwell on past mistakes; focus on the future.
examples_extra: Try hard not to dwell on the sad past.
She dwells far too much on every mistake.
note_fa: درنگ کردن روی چیزی؛ فکر طولانی.

meaning_en: To dismiss employees due to economic reasons.
example_en: The company had to lay off staff due to reduced demand.
examples_extra: The firm had to lay off workers.
They will lay off fifty staff.

meaning_en: To continue doing something despite difficulties.
example_en: Despite the challenges, we must press on with our work.
examples_extra: Despite the rain, they pressed on.
We must press on with the reforms.
note_fa: ادامه دادن؛ پافشاری با وجود دشواری.

meaning_en: To assemble or create something from parts.
example_en: We need to put together a strong presentation.
examples_extra: They put together a strong team.
It took ages to put together the report.

meaning_en: to do something too quickly without thinking
meaning_fa: عجولانه عمل کردن، شتاب‌زده تصمیم گرفتن
example_en: Don't rush into making such an important decision.
examples_extra: Do not rush into a decision you might regret.
They rushed into marriage after only three months.

meaning_en: To become comfortable and accustomed to a new place.
example_en: It took a few weeks to settle in to my new apartment.
examples_extra: She settled in very quickly.
It took months to settle in.

meaning_en: To remain in a place or continue in a job.
example_en: He decided to stay on at university for his master's.
examples_extra: She decided to stay on at university.
Will you stay on after lunch?

meaning_en: Start doing something with great energy and enthusiasm.
example_en: She decided to throw herself into her new project.
examples_extra: She will throw herself into her studies.
He will throw himself into the new job.

meaning_en: To encourage someone to do something.
example_en: The crowd urged on their team to score.
examples_extra: The crowd urged the team on loudly.
Fans urged them on to victory.
